description_en: Queries outbound call records of agents based on a conditional query
description_zh: 根据条件查询座席外呼通话记录
name: CloudQueryObCdr

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Call Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: If the uniqueId value is not empty, all other parameters are ignored and only the record with the specified phone unique identifier is queried
parameters.help_zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en: Queries the record corresponding to the specified request unique ID. By default, the current month is queried. If the requestUniqueId does not belong to the current month, pass the query parameter startTime as a pass-through query parameter
parameters.help_zh: 查询请求唯一id对应的记录信息，默认查询当前月，如requestUniqueId不属于当前月，查询时请传递查询参数 查询开始时间(startTime)
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The call type. Leave empty for all types. Valid values:
4: Preview outbound call.
6: Caller outbound call.
9: Internal call
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫类型；为空表示全部，可选值为：4:预览外呼 6:主叫外呼 9:内部呼叫
parameters.name: call_type

parameters.help_en:
The call result. Parameter description:
30: Agent did not answer.
31: Agent answered, customer not called.
32: Agent answered, customer did not answer.
33: Both parties answered.
50: Caller outbound call answered.
51: Caller outbound call, customer did not answer.
52: Caller outbound call, both parties answered
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明：30 座席未接听; 31 座席接听,未呼叫客户; 32 座席接听,客户未接听; 33 双方接听; 50 主叫外呼接听; 51 主叫外呼,客户未接听; 52 主叫外呼,双方接听
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The province to which the customer phone number belongs. Leave empty for all provinces. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city to which the customer phone number belongs. Leave empty for all cities. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en:
The time range type that determines how the startTime and endTime parameters take effect for call records. This parameter takes effect only when startTime and endTime are not empty. Valid values:
1: Call start time.
2: Call end time.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: The query start time in UNIX timestamp format, accurate to seconds. startTime and endTime cannot span across months. Default value: the first day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The query end time in UNIX timestamp format, accurate to seconds. startTime and endTime cannot span across months. Default value: the last day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The offset from which to start retrieving records. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of records to retrieve. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed 1000. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The custom parameter for field-specific search key. When this parameter is passed, userFieldValue must also be passed. Only one field can be queried. Fuzzy match is not supported. The custom field-specific search condition is constructed as: {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_fieldkey

parameters.help_en: The custom parameter for field-specific search value. When this parameter is passed, userFieldKey must also be passed. Only one field can be queried. Fuzzy match is not supported. The custom field-specific search condition is constructed as: {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_field_value

parameters.help_en: The customer number. You can specify one or more customer numbers separated by commas (,). A maximum of 100 numbers can be specified at a time. Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 客户号码，支持一个或多个客户号码查询，多个客户号码以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持100个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: customer_number

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. Each agent ID is 3 to 10 characters long. You can specify one or more agent IDs separated by commas (,). A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified at a time. Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号，单个座席工号3-10位，支持一个或多个座席工号查询，多个座席工号以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持100个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The outbound call group to which the agent belongs. Each group ID is 2 to 20 characters long. You can specify one or more group IDs separated by commas (,). A maximum of 10 IDs can be specified at a time. Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属外呼组 单个外呼组号2-20位，支持一个或多个座席工号查询，多个座席工号以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持10个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: gno

parameters.help_en: The agent number
parameters.help_zh: 座席号码
parameters.name: agent_number

parameters.help_en: The agent name
parameters.help_zh: 座席姓名
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the caller ID displayed to the customer
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码过滤条件
parameters.name: clid

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the actual caller ID displayed to the customer. When a virtual number is used for AXB outbound calls and the switch is enabled, the actual caller ID displayed to the customer is the virtual number
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧真实外显号码过滤条件，当使用虚拟号进行AXB外呼且开关打开时，实际过滤的客户侧真实外显号码是虚拟号
parameters.name: left_display_number

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
0: Ascending by record creation time.
1: Descending by record creation time.
2: Ascending by end time.
3: Descending by end time
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式；取值说明：0: 按照记录产生的时序顺序排序，1：按照记录产生的时序逆序排序，2: 按照结束时间的时序顺序排序，3：按照结束时间的时序逆序排序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the total count. Valid values:
0: Does not return the total count.
1: Returns the total count.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回总条数；取值说明：0: 不返回，1：返回，不传默认为1
parameters.name: return_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the call is downgraded. Valid values:
0: No.
1: Yes
parameters.help_zh: 是否呼叫降级；0-否, 1-是
parameters.name: down_grade

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the call was answered by a real person. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No
parameters.help_zh: 真人接听；取值说明：1-是、0-否
parameters.name: is_real_answer

List.description_zh: 座席外呼通话记录数组

AgentNumber.title_zh: 座席电话 区号 +7或8位的固话号码，区号与固话号码之间无'-'；或11位长度的手机号码。0104100596

AnswerTime.title_zh: 座席接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

BridgeDuration.description_en: The service processing duration, in seconds
BridgeDuration.description_zh: 服务处理时长秒数，单位是s
BridgeDuration.title_zh: 服务处理时长秒数，单位是s

BridgeTime.description_en: The time when both parties were connected. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, such as 1480904471
BridgeTime.description_zh: 双方接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
BridgeTime.title_zh: 双方接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

CallId.description_en: The unique ID of the call

CallType.description_en:
The call type. Valid values:
4: preview outbound call.
6: caller outbound call

CallType.title_zh: 呼叫类型：4、预览外呼; 6、主叫外呼

CalleeRingingTime.description_en: The ringing time on the customer side. This is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds, such as 1480904471
CalleeRingingTime.description_zh: 客户侧响铃时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
CalleeRingingTime.title_zh: 客户侧响铃时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

Clid.description_en: The display number on the customer side. When a virtual number is used for AXB outbound calls and the switch is enabled, the actual display number returned on the customer side is the virtual number
Clid.description_zh: 客户侧外显号码，当使用虚拟号进行AXB外呼且开关打开时，实际返回的客户侧外显号码是虚拟号
Clid.title_zh: 客户侧外显号码，当使用虚拟号进行AXB外呼且开关打开时，实际返回的客户侧外显号码是虚拟号

CustomerAreaCode.description_en: The area code of the customer phone number

CustomerCity.description_en: The city to which the customer number belongs, such as Beijing
CustomerCity.description_zh: 客户号码归属城市,北京
CustomerCity.title_zh: 客户号码归属城市,北京

CustomerNumber.description_en: The customer number. For domestic landlines or mobile phones, the format is area code + 7- or 8-digit landline number with no hyphen between the area code and the number, or an 11-digit mobile number. For example, 01041005968 or 18701051984. For the virtual number with extension scenario, the format is virtual number-extension, such as 18701051984-7538
CustomerNumber.description_zh: 客户号码 国内固话或手机，区号 + 7或8位的固话号码，区号与固话号码之间无'-'；或11位长度的手机号码。如 01041005968或18701051984 或虚拟号-分机号场景格式，如 18701051984-7538
CustomerNumber.title_zh: 客户号码 国内固话或手机，区号 + 7或8位的固话号码，区号与固话号码之间无'-'；或11位长度的手机号码。如 01041005968或18701051984 或虚拟号-分机号场景格式，如 18701051984-7538

CustomerProvince.description_en: The province to which the customer number belongs, such as Beijing
CustomerProvince.description_zh: 客户号码归属省份，如 北京
CustomerProvince.title_zh: 客户号码归属省份，如 北京

DisplayNumber.description_en: The actual display number on the agent side. When the AXB scenario is used for outbound calls, the actual display number on the agent side is a virtual number
DisplayNumber.description_zh: 座席侧真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，座席侧真实外显号码为虚拟号
DisplayNumber.title_zh: 座席侧真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，座席侧真实外显号码为虚拟号

DownGrade.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was downgraded. Valid values:
0: No.
1: Yes

EndReason.description_en:
The end reason, which indicates the hangup reason after the call is answered. Valid values:
1000: The primary channel hung up.
1001: A non-primary channel hung up.
1002: The call was forcibly disconnected
EndReason.description_zh: 结束原因,接听之后的挂机原因 1000:主通道挂机 1001:非主通道挂机 1002:被强拆
EndReason.title_zh: 结束原因,接听之后的挂机原因 1000:主通道挂机 1001:非主通道挂机 1002:被强拆

EndTime.description_en: The call end time. This is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds, such as 1480904471
EndTime.description_zh: 电话结束时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
EndTime.title_zh: 电话结束时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

Gno.description_en: The agent outbound call group number

IsRealAnswer.description_en: Indicates whether the call was answered by a real person. Valid values: 1: yes. 0: no. Empty value: unknown
IsRealAnswer.description_zh: 是否真人接听：1 - 是、0 - 否、空值
IsRealAnswer.title_zh: 是否真人接听：1 - 是、0 - 否、空值

LeftDisplayNumber.description_en: The actual display number shown to the customer. When the AXB scenario is used for outbound calls, the actual display number on the customer side is a virtual number
LeftDisplayNumber.description_zh: 客户侧真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，客户侧真实外显号码为虚拟号
LeftDisplayNumber.title_zh: 客户侧真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，客户侧真实外显号码为虚拟号

MainRingingTime.description_en:
The time when the phone started ringing for an extension outbound call.

This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
MainRingingTime.description_zh:
分机外呼，话机响铃时间

使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为秒
MainRingingTime.title_zh: 分机外呼，话机响铃时间

RealAnswerTime.description_en: The time when a real person answered the call. This is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds, such as 1480904471
RealAnswerTime.description_zh: 真人接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
RealAnswerTime.title_zh: 真人接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

Monitor_type.description_en:
The recording type. Valid values:
1: Mixed recording.
2: Separate-channel recording (two mono WAV files are retained).
3: Voice mail.
5: Separate-channel recording (one stereo WAV file is retained)
Monitor_type.description_zh: 混音 2. 分线录音（保留2个单声道WAV） 3.留言 5. 分线录音（保留1个双声道WAV）
Monitor_type.title_zh: 混音 2. 分线录音（保留2个单声道WAV） 3.留言 5. 分线录音（保留1个双声道WAV）

Type.description_en:
The recording file type. Valid values:
record: recording.
voicemail: voice mail
Type.description_zh: 取值：record,voicemail 说明：record是录音， voicemail是留言
Type.title_zh: 取值：record,voicemail 说明：record是录音， voicemail是留言

RecordFile.title_zh: 通话记录录音数组，json格式

RtcTotalDuration.description_en: The RTC total call duration in seconds. This value is valid when the call type is caller outbound call (RTC). Calculation rule: endTime - startTime
RtcTotalDuration.description_zh: RTC总通话时长秒数，单位是s，在呼叫类型为主叫外呼(RTC)时有效，计算规则：endTime-startTime
RtcTotalDuration.title_zh: RTC总通话时长秒数，单位是s，在呼叫类型为主叫外呼(RTC)时有效，计算规则：endTime-startTime

SipCause.description_en: The SIP response code, ranging from 200 to 699. Note: For caller outbound calls using RTC, there is no SIP negotiation on the agent side and no call is initiated, so this value defaults to 0
SipCause.description_zh: SIP响应码：200 ~ 699 详见 注：主叫外呼RTC座席侧没有SIP协商的概念，并未发起呼叫，因此该值默认为0
SipCause.title_zh: SIP响应码：200 ~ 699 详见 注：主叫外呼RTC座席侧没有SIP协商的概念，并未发起呼叫，因此该值默认为0

StartTime.description_en: The time when the agent started the outbound call. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, such as 1480904471
StartTime.description_zh: 座席开始外呼时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
StartTime.title_zh: 座席开始外呼时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

Status.description_en:
The outbound call result. Valid values:
30: The agent did not answer.
31: The agent answered but did not call the customer.
32: The agent answered but the customer did not answer.
33: Both parties answered.
50: The caller outbound call was answered.
51: The caller outbound call was made but the customer did not answer.
52: The caller outbound call was made and both parties answered
Status.description_zh: 外呼结果：30 座席未接听; 31 座席接听,未呼叫客户; 32 座席接听,客户未接听; 33 双方接听; 50 主叫外呼接听; 51 主叫外呼,客户未接听; 52 主叫外呼,双方接听
Status.title_zh: 外呼结果：30 座席未接听; 31 座席接听,未呼叫客户; 32 座席接听,客户未接听; 33 双方接听; 50 主叫外呼接听; 51 主叫外呼,客户未接听; 52 主叫外呼,双方接听。

StatusReason.description_en:
The call status reason (for caller outbound calls). Valid values:
1: Enterprise blacklist.
2: Intercepted by the risk control system.
20001: Call restriction.
20002: Blacklisted or not whitelisted.
20003: Restricted calling time period.
3: Invalid display number.
4: Incorrect voice navigation.
5: Enterprise suspended.
6: No permission for outbound calls.
7: Exceeded call count limit.
8: Incorrect number.
9: Other errors
StatusReason.description_zh: 通话状态原因（主叫外呼）描述：1 - 企业黑名单; 2 - 风控系统拦截; 20001 - 呼叫限制；20002 - 黑名单或非白名单；20003 - 禁拨时间段； 3 - 无效的外显号码; 4 - 错误的语音导航; 5 - 企业停机; 6 - 无权限外呼; 7 - 超出呼叫次数限制; 8 - 错误号码; 9 - 其他错误；
StatusReason.title_zh: 通话状态原因（主叫外呼）描述：1 - 企业黑名单; 2 - 风控系统拦截; 20001 - 呼叫限制；20002 - 黑名单或非白名单；20003 - 禁拨时间段； 3 - 无效的外显号码; 4 - 错误的语音导航; 5 - 企业停机; 6 - 无权限外呼; 7 - 超出呼叫次数限制; 8 - 错误号码; 9 - 其他错误；

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the agent automatic outbound call task

TotalDuration.description_zh: 总通话时长秒数，单位是s
TotalDuration.title_zh: 总通话时长秒数，单位是s

TsiFile.description_en: The name of the color ring back tone file

TsiFileFormat.description_en: The color ring back tone file type

UserField.description_en: The custom field for call records, in JSON format
UserField.description_zh: 通话记录自定义字段，json格式
UserField.title_zh: 通话记录自定义字段，json格式

VadIn.description_en: The call quality percentage. The value ranges from 0 to 100, indicating the percentage of speaking time in the inbound direction
VadIn.description_zh: 通话质量百分比,数据是0-100之间，in方向说话占用的百分比
VadIn.title_zh: 通话质量百分比,数据是0-100之间，in方向说话占用的百分比

VadOut.title_zh: 通话质量百分比,数据是0-100之间，out方向说话占用的百分比

WaitDuration.description_zh: 客户等待时长秒数，单位是s
WaitDuration.title_zh: 客户等待时长秒数，单位是s
